details: Ripple has received full MiCA (Markets in Crypto-Assets) CASP (Crypto-Asset Service Provider) authorization from Luxembourg's financial regulator, CSSF. This approval allows Ripple to offer crypto-asset services across all 30 countries in the European Economic Area (EEA), signaling a significant step for its expansion in Europe under new regulatory frameworks.
title: Ripple Gains MiCA Crypto-Asset Service Provider Authorization in EEA

details: Vanguard, a financial giant, is signaling a deeper push into the crypto space with a new job posting for a Head of Digital Assets. This move could significantly influence how cryptocurrencies reach a broader investor base, potentially impacting millions of investors.
title: Vanguard Hints at Deeper Crypto Involvement with New Digital Assets Role

details: Clearstream, a major post-trade services provider, has expanded its crypto custody service to include several altcoins, namely XRP, Solana (SOL), Cardano (ADA), Litecoin (LTC), Stellar (XLM), and Avalanche (AVAX). This move reflects growing institutional demand for MiCA-ready assets.
title: Clearstream Expands Crypto Custody to Include XRP, SOL, ADA, LTC, XLM, AVAX

details: Bitcoin and broader crypto markets have experienced technical weakness and declines, with an estimated $500 billion vanishing from markets, attributed to escalating geopolitical tensions between the US and Iran and renewed risk-off sentiment.
title: Bitcoin Dips Amid US-Iran Tensions, $500B Vanishes from Markets

details: Despite broader market weakness, Bitcoin and Ether ETFs have attracted a combined $286 million in inflows, indicating sustained investor interest in these regulated crypto investment products.
title: Bitcoin and Ether ETFs See $286 Million Inflows

details: Russia has reportedly removed the requirement for mandatory wallet reporting from its final cryptocurrency bill. This change could signal a more favorable regulatory environment for crypto users and businesses within Russia.
title: Russia's Final Crypto Bill Omits Mandatory Wallet Reporting
